content_sections.heading: About FACT
content_sections.text: The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited describes itself as a multi-divisional Central PSE and a pioneer in the manufacture of Fertilisers and Chemicals. Its activities are spread over manufacturing, engineering design and consultancy, fabrication and more. The notice is issued by the Deputy General Manager (HR), and applications go to the HR Department, FEDO Building, Udyogamandal.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is Officer (Legal Services), post code 1. The essential qualification is Graduation in Law with 2 years post-qualification experience in the relevant field. If there are not enough candidates with the prescribed 2 years of experience, candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may be considered. A 5-year integrated dual degree in Law (B.A. LL.B./B.B.A. LL.B./B.Com. LL.B. or equivalent) is also considered. The minimum two years of post-qualification experience must be in the relevant field as either of these: Law/Legal Officer in the legal department of a Central Public Sector Undertaking, State Public Sector Undertaking, Central Government Department, State Government Department, University or Private Limited Company sector organisation; OR An advocate before any court of law/Tribunal. The experience counts only after enrolment with the Bar Council, and the Bar Council registration certificate must be uploaded with the online application. Experience in either or both capacities may be counted, provided the periods do not overlap. Only post-qualification experience as on 01.11.2026 is considered. The educational qualification must be approved or recognised by UGC, AIU or the Bar Council of India. Candidates with qualifications from foreign universities must produce the order or letter under which AIU approved or recognised it. The qualification must be from a full time regular course. Candidates who studied part time or through correspondence, distance, private study or off campus courses are not eligible to apply. For ex-servicemen, the essential qualification acquired or awarded as part of their service, with a certificate issued by the Armed Forces, is considered eligible. The relevant date for qualification, experience, age and all other eligibility criteria is 01.11.2026. The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on 01.11.2026. Eligible candidates should have been born on or between 01.11.1991 and 31.10.2008. Matriculation / School leaving certificate granted by the Board of Secondary Education is the only acceptable proof of age. Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, PWBD and Ex-Servicemen applies as per Government Directives. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Candidates offered engagement with two years' experience are paid a consolidated Rs.32,890 per month. Candidates appointed with one to less than two years' experience are paid a consolidated Rs.31,930 per month. Both get an increase of 3% on successful completion of each year. Leave, ESI, Provident Fund, and TA & DA for duty travel apply based on eligibility, as per the Rules of the Company. The engagement is for two years, renewable for a maximum period of 2 spells of one year each, at the discretion of the Management, subject to requirement, performance and assessment. It is liable to be terminated by the Management with 15 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice, at its discretion and without assigning any reason. The engagement is for a fixed term only and gives no right to extension, permanent appointment or preferential treatment in appointment in the Company.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are first shortlisted on their qualification and experience as per the documents they submit. Selection is then based on the marks scored in the interview. The notice does not give an interview date or venue. The Management reserves the right to shortlist candidates by methods or criteria it finds suitable and to modify the mode of selection. Its decision on these is final and binding, and no correspondence is entertained. Eligibility is decided from the information and documents submitted, and candidature is provisional at all stages. Engagement from the panels is at the sole discretion of the Management, based on requirements and following reservation rules. Candidates from the panel may also be considered for engagement for shorter periods, at rates and terms fixed by the Company.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FACT Officer (Legal Services)?
faq.answer: The Online Form must be submitted by 4.00 PM on 19.11.2026, and the hard copy must reach FACT on or before 26.11.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for FACT Officer (Legal Services)?
faq.answer: Graduation in Law with 2 years post-qualification experience in the relevant field. Candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may be considered if there are not enough candidates with 2 years. A 5-year integrated dual degree in Law is also considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for FACT Officer (Legal Services)?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on 01.11.2026, with candidates born on or between 01.11.1991 and 31.10.2008. Relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL) and 10 years for PwBD (40% and above).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for FACT Officer (Legal Services)?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs.32,890 per month with two years' experience, or Rs.31,930 per month with one to less than two years' experience. Both get a 3% increase on completing each year.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for FACT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the Online Form through www.fact.co.in, upload the signed Application Form, then send the original with self-attested documents by Speed Post/Registered Post to DGM (HR), HR Department, FEDO Building, FACT, Udyogamandal, PIN–683501.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for FACT Officer (Legal Services)?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification and experience as per their documents, and selection is based on the marks scored in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the FACT Officer (Legal Services) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a Fixed Tenure Contract (Adhoc basis) for two years, renewable for a maximum of 2 spells of one year each, and it gives no right to permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Can distance or part-time Law degree holders apply?
faq.answer: No. The qualification must be from a full time regular course, and part time, correspondence, distance, private study or off campus candidates are not eligible. Ex-servicemen with a qualification awarded in service are considered eligible.

faq.question: Q9. Is the online application enough for FACT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. An online form without the uploaded Application Form, or a postal application without the Online Form, is not accepted, and the hard copy must reach FACT by 26.11.2026.

faq.question: Q10. Do HRA or other benefits come with the FACT Officer (Legal Services) pay?
faq.answer: The notice says leave, ESI, Provident Fund, and TA & DA for duty travel apply based on eligibility, as per Company Rules. It does not mention HRA.
